name: health-check
description: Quick health check: load average, memory, and connectivity
command: echo '{"load": "'$(uptime | awk -F'load average:' '{print $2}' | xargs)'", "memory_free_mb": '$(vm_stat 2>/dev/null | awk '/Pages free/{gsub(/\./,"",$3); print int($3*4096/1048576)}' || free -m 2>/dev/null | awk '/Mem:/{print $4}' || echo 0)', "timestamp": "'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)'"}'
